contract: doltlite.h exposes the bundled SQLite declarations plus the documented DoltLite APIs; libdoltlite exports sqlite3_* and the exact documented DoltLite entry points
DoltLite-format databases use the prolly engine while stock SQLite files route to the original B-tree without Dolt version control
DoltLite-format databases do not create SQLite rollback-journal WAL or shared-memory sidecars
transactions that write more than one file-backed database are rejected and rolled back in full
journal_mode reports wal and ignores mode changes on DoltLite-format databases
all WAL checkpoint modes run DoltLite garbage collection and report zero WAL frames
auto_vacuum reports zero and attempts to enable it or run incremental_vacuum are no-ops
VACUUM runs DoltLite garbage collection instead of rebuilding SQLite pages
SQLITE_DBCONFIG_RESET_DATABASE plus VACUUM empties the current branch working catalog and zeros user_version and application_id; other branches and HEAD history remain
VACUUM inside an open transaction fails with cannot VACUUM from within a transaction, matching stock
VACUUM INTO writes a compacted DoltLite-format copy and rejects a non-empty existing target like stock
VACUUM INTO ':memory:' is refused because a chunk-store copy needs a file; an expression that resolves to ':memory:' is refused the same way
DoltLite-format databases remain UTF-8 when UTF-16 encoding is requested
PRAGMA query_only and the immutable=1 URI parameter refuse version-control writes with SQLITE_READONLY, matching how they refuse DML
application-defined collations work for expressions and unindexed columns; persisted prolly indexes require a built-in collation and prevent replacing its callback while they use that name
a non-INTEGER PRIMARY KEY table is keyed by its primary key; rowid and last_insert_rowid() expose that PK as an integer or a stable hash; explicit WITHOUT ROWID has no rowid

clustered non-INTEGER PRIMARY KEY rowid is a read-only SQL alias: SELECT and last_insert_rowid work; INSERT and UPDATE of rowid fail like explicit WITHOUT ROWID; TEMP and INTEGER PRIMARY KEY still match SQLite
sqlite3_table_column_metadata reports the visible INTEGER rowid on clustered PRIMARY KEY tables like stock; explicit WITHOUT ROWID still has no rowid
a non-INTEGER PRIMARY KEY is clustered like WITHOUT ROWID: PRAGMA table_info reports the PK NOT NULL and INSERT NULL fails; TEMP tables and INTEGER PRIMARY KEY still match SQLite

contract: sqlite_master.sql is canonical catalog text after a schema commit, not the original DDL spelling; row order follows the catalog
SELECT unknown(...) returns NULL and PRAGMA function_list lists unknown, matching the stock sqlite3 shell; unrecognized names other than unknown still error
backup_step copies a file-backed, attached, or in-memory DoltLite database in one operation
sqlite3_serialize and sqlite3_deserialize use a contiguous native DoltLite database image that preserves rows, schema, refs, history, and working state
dbstat on a DoltLite-format database errors because the chunk store has no SQLite page layout; it does not report an empty database
